learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how to carefully observe the world outside and draw beautiful scenes just like a real artist capturing a photograph!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A window acts just like a picture frame! It helps artists choose exactly which part of the big wide world they want to include in their drawing.
Things that are close to your window look very big and detailed. Things that are far away, like hills or distant trees, look tiny and lighter in color.
Look closely at the shapes of leaves, the colors of buildings, and the clouds in the sky. Adding these tiny details makes your drawing look real and interesting.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Window World Drawing!
fun_activity.instructions: Sit by your favorite window with a drawing pad. Draw exactly what you see through the glass, making sure to show what is close to you and what is far away!

quick_recap: ⭐ A window helps us frame our drawing so we know exactly what to focus on.
⭐ Objects closer to us look bigger, and objects far away look smaller.
⭐ Paying attention to small details makes our artwork super special.
